description: This Java source file defines the `Category` class, which serves as an entity representing product categories in an e-commerce catalog system. It includes fields for ID, merchant store association, hierarchical parent category, visibility, sorting order, descriptions, and timestamps for creation and updates. It utilizes JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Entity class representing a product category, including hierarchical and descriptive attributes.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the UUID identifier of the category.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the UUID identifier of the category.

methods.name: getMerchantStoreId
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the merchant store associated with this category.

methods.name: setMerchantStoreId
methods.description: Sets the UUID of the merchant store.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the sorting order of the category.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sorting order of the category.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the category is visible.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility status of the category.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent category, if any.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of descriptions for this category.

methods.name: setDescriptions

methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the category was created.
